description: Get the link that lets the user buy or change a Writavo plan in their browser, with a plan and billing interval preselected. It spends nothing and changes nothing: the user reviews the price and pays on Stripe's secure page, never in this chat. A plan buys the AI article pipeline (credits, AI generation, SEO features); storing, publishing and importing content needs no plan. If a key is configured, the reply includes the current plan.

interval.description: Monthly or yearly billing, to preselect. Omit to let the user choose.

plan.description: The plan to preselect. Omit to let the user choose on the page.

name: start_plan_purchase
title: Get a plan purchase link
